body:
Long before electricity, copper was recognized as a mystical metal—a physical conduit for spiritual energy. From ancient Egypt to Ayurveda, Indigenous traditions to Greek mythology, copper has always served as a bridge between worlds. It was used to sterilize, energize, protect, and transform—and now it’s your turn to experience it in its purest form.

Our Solid Copper Plate is 99.9% pure and crafted for intentional use. When you place your crystals or tools on this plate, their energy doesn’t just rest—it circulates, grounds, and amplifies. Copper clears energetic stagnation and strengthens whatever intention you set, making it one of the most powerful materials you can bring into your healing space.

This is the exact plate featured in Heather’s Copper Class, where she teaches how to use it for crystal grids, manifestation rituals, and energy field enhancement. Its weight and conductivity give it a deep, anchoring presence—one that brings harmony, clarity, and purpose to your spiritual practice.
